category.baseline_origin: Ethiopian, blend washed natural, light roast

deviations.summary: Washed + natural blend from same origin
deviations.brewing_impact: Wider parameter space, more conservative recipe bands
deviations.narrative_hook: This blend marries washed clarity with natural fruit intensity.

flavor_prediction.expect: mixed berries, sweet tea, raw honey, plum
flavor_prediction.brewer_effect: Balanced extraction highlighting the bean's natural character.

sour.explanation: Underextracted — only acids extracted so far. Finer grind increases surface area for more extraction.

bitter.explanation: Overextracted — bitter dry distillates dominating. Coarser grind reduces extraction.

thin.primary: Increase dose by 1g or decrease water by 15g
thin.secondary: Try a metal filter for more body
thin.explanation: Understrength — TDS too low. More coffee or less water concentrates the brew.

strong.primary: Decrease dose by 1g or increase water by 15g
strong.explanation: Overstrength — TDS too high. Less coffee or more water dilutes the brew.

flat.primary: Grind finer by ~22μm and increase temp by 2°C
flat.secondary: Check bean freshness and water mineral content
flat.explanation: Either stale beans or underextracted. If water is very soft, mineral content may be too low for proper extraction.

cold-brew.narrative: Ethiopian heirlooms grind differently — harder, more brittle, more fines. Elevated fines actually help extraction evenness with paper filter. Cold brew can't extract light roast properly. Use flash brew (hot water over ice) to preserve the bright, complex character cold immersion would lose.
